decisions.reason: The source also sets the stuffed dolls blog image count to 3-4, but that impact is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The existing publication condition already requires images and internal links before publication; specifying link destinations for the stuffed dolls blog does not change that condition.
The source specifies images and internal-link destinations, not blog keyword selection.
The source concerns edits to an existing stuffed dolls article and does not alter the topic-selection workflow.
The reference to stuffed dolls is descriptive of the blog article and does not change the webpage replacement text.
The source does not modify campaign keyword count, selection, or page mapping.
Internal links within the stuffed dolls blog are distinct from the off-page backlink deliverable and do not change its count or link-type percentages.
